title: Unbalanced Minimal Matchings for Measurable Scale Invariant Costs on $\mathbb{R}^d$
summary: Given red and blue points drawn from Poisson point processes of equal intensities, we match them by locally minimizing a cost function. In our paper, we identify all possible measurable cost functions on $\mathbb{R}^d$ such that the resulting matching is scale invariant. Our cost functions can be asymmetrical, which we refer to as unbalanced cost functions. The investigation is motivated by arXiv:2012.07129 where the authors consider scale invariant cost functions with added regularity assumptions.
